LESSON: UNITY OF MUSLIMS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Islamic Heritage and Civilisation
Topic 7.2: Unity of Muslims

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Unity of Muslims. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Unity of Muslims
2. Practise Unity of Muslims at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Unity of Muslims

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Unity of Muslims
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Unity of Muslims. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Unity of Muslims at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Unity of Muslims at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Unity of Muslims
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Unity of Muslims. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Unity of Muslims using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Unity of Muslims in the examples.
2. Explain Unity of Muslims to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Unity of Muslims.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Unity of Muslims using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Unity of Muslims important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Unity of Muslims
2. Practise Unity of Muslims at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Unity of Muslims

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
